findings.text: follow-on: dispatch_repair_for_run and the review-subject composers at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:810,824,869 still call _review_lane_candidates/_review_lane_plan/_no_lane_reason without a session, so a lift scoped to the asking session is invisible on those paths and the parity the repair restores in the composed-review path is not held across the whole reflex family.

follow-on: the negative control's arm A counts the exclusion case among its three failures, but that case fails with a TypeError from the changed helper signature rather than a reverted clause, so only the reset case in arm A and the reset case in arm B demonstrate a behavioural revert.

follow-on: the after_suite command field reads "cd <worktree> && PYTHONPATH=<worktree> ...", so the record's own command is not the literal command the store expects even though log_path resolves to a log whose header carries it; carried from the prior review and unchanged by this increment.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from ebcb2cbc4436cb3f65bebd74bd54a37f74f1b4e0 to 81867f41ce84e4fddc0c249faae2f11b647e8c85; two commits touch four files, all inside the declared scope, and the fix threads session=fields["session"] from the compose path into the lane helpers.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_jev_routes_with_the_session_admission_and_the_lift.py and a base/head gate; the manifest records 11 passed and both gate logs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that Jev's rendered state and guidance carry the session's own worker slots and any lift; the increment answers the prior blocking finding and reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1108-1117 now resolves the reflex lift with the published reading and the asking session.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at runs/r-20261015T075223938148-jev-routes-with-the-session-admission-and-the-lift/manifest.md; status complete, recording the repair commit, the two-arm negative control, and the base/head gate logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the gained diff writes exactly the four declared paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_jev_routes_with_the_session_admission_and_the_lift.py:553 and :565-575 assert independent outcomes that the negative control reddens when each clause is reverted.
justifications.evidence: gate-base-round2.log and gate-head-round3.log share the same three failure ids (test_congested_local_lane_still_reaches_the_picker.py::test_congested_local_lane_routing[alpha], [explicit], test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py::test_a_discarded_run_is_not_recreated) so added_failure_count is 0, and the node test file re-ran at head with 11 passed.
justifications.fit: the added session keyword matches the sibling callers of budget_lift.effective_budget at reckon/crew/budget_group.py:210 and reckon/budget.py:2651.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1108-1117 resolves the reflex lift through the one resolver with the published reading and the asking session.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1108 reads through the existing budget_lift.published_readings rather than a second reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: the gained diff touches only the four declared paths.
